name: nicetry/white-list
description: White List: addresses that never meet an enforcement. An administrator lists IPs and CIDR ranges by hand, under a name and a category, and a visitor on one is never sent to the gym, held in a tarpit, blocked, or dropped in the blackhole — while still showing up in Activity and reports. The one place to keep an office, a partner's scanner, or a crawler you trust out of harm's way.
